sentences.en: The bag-packer decided to hike the Appalachian Trail.
sentences.zh: 背包客决定徒步美国阿巴拉契亚山径。

sentences.en: She's a seasoned bag-packer who loves exploring remote areas.
sentences.zh: 她是一位经验丰富的背包客，喜欢探索偏远地区。

sentences.en: The hostel was full, so the bag-packer had to camp outside instead.
sentences.zh: 旅舍满了，所以背包客只能在外面露营。

senses.zh: 肩背大包自助旅行的人
